requirements.text: The library management system shall ensure that no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously.
The library management system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours of the due date.
The library management system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The library management system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The library management system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The library management system shall log all transactions and user actions for audit purposes.
The library management system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The library management system shall limit simultaneous borrowing operations to 5 during peak times with strict monitoring.
The library management system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The library management system shall implement role-based access control for librarians and members.
The library management system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The library management system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The library management system shall implement energy-efficient servers and infrastructure to minimize energy consumption.
The library management system shall allow librarians to add or remove books with a latency of less than 3 seconds per operation.
The library management system shall provide digital notifications for overdue books to reduce paper waste.
The library management system shall provide a mechanism to report and manage overdue books securely.
The library management system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding library services.
The library management system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.
